audit.why: 8.5/10 difficulty against a 50.51% win rate over 2752 games fits: an even lane that is hard to play, because Sion has to win it before Silver Bolts scales.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Vayne Levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 while the prose on the same page (whys[1], whys[2], whys[4], spikes[0], spikes[1], early, mid) says Sion wins exactly those stages. Both layers were wrong and agreed with each other, so the page read coherently while contradicting its own advice.
audit.why: Vayne needs three autos for a Silver Bolts proc and has no kill pressure at level 1; Sion's W-shield at 2 and full Q-E-W at 3 are his strongest windows, and level 6 Unstoppable Onslaught is the gap-closer Tumble cannot answer. The packet level chart independently reads Skill/Sion/Sion/Skill/Sion/Skill/Vayne.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Sion, Sion, Skill, Sion, Skill, Vayne across both layers with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns were never stated. Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s and Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s — a 3-to-1 gap that decides every commit — and spikes[2] attributed Vayne's max-HP shred to Blade of the Ruined King rather than to Silver Bolts itself.
audit.why: Silver Bolts is her percent-max-health true damage on the third consecutive hit; conflating it with an item misplaces the threat and the timing.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into whys[3]; spikes[2] rewritten around Silver Bolts.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] titled 'Fight her at 2 items' carried a body about channeling Q in the open, which does not explain the heading.
audit.why: The two-item don't is about Silver Bolts scaling off the HP Sion stacks, not about Q telegraphs.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 she kites freely with Tumble and no R threat limits you — fake Q charges to burn her Tumble on positioning rather than dodging your actual cast.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 she kites freely — Tumble is a 4s cooldown while Condemn sits at 18s, so bait the Tumble with a fake Q charge and commit the real one while Condemn is spent.

edits.before: Heartsteel's HP compound starts, but Vayne's Blade of the Ruined King spike means she now shreds 10% max HP per three-stack proc — the race tightens.
edits.after: Heartsteel's HP compound starts, but every third hit is a Silver Bolts percent-max-HP true-damage chunk your armour cannot touch — the race tightens.

edits.before: Channeling Q in the open â€” telegraphed Q is dodged Q, and you just stood still for his full combo.
edits.after: Silver Bolts scales off the max HP you stack — every Heartsteel proc feeds her, so win lane early.

Sion's R carries no 'unstoppable' field in the kit and Riot's text does not address displacement, so the page's existing advice (R from outside Condemn range) was left as is rather than asserting either way.
